about.text: Basa is a fresh soft cheese from Lika. It is prepared from mixed sheep's and cow's milk.

sources.text: Lika and Bosnian Krajina; soft white spread, curd drained about 18 h then mixed with cream and salt, no ageing; coagulation type not stated in source (acid assumed)
